elements.label: Figure 3.13
elements.description: Grouped vertical bar chart titled 'Figure 3.13. Share of provincial population that is ethnic minority'. Y-axis: 'Share of provincial population that is ethnic minority (%)', ticks at 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15. X-axis categories: Bac Ninh, Hung Yen, Hai Phong, Hai Duong, Vinh Phuc, Hanoi, Quang Ninh. Legend: 2009 (teal), 2019 (orange). No values are printed on the bars; approximate readings: Bac Ninh 2009 ~0.3, 2019 ~5.5; Hung Yen 2009 ~0.1, 2019 ~0.9; Hai Phong 2009 ~0.2, 2019 ~0.4; Hai Duong 2009 ~0.3, 2019 ~0.6; Vinh Phuc 2009 ~4.3, 2019 ~4.8; Hanoi 2009 ~1.3, 2019 ~1.4; Quang Ninh 2009 ~11.7, 2019 ~12.2. Source note: 2009 and 2019 Census. Pattern: the ethnic minority share is highest in Quang Ninh and Vinh Phuc in both years, and lowest in Hung Yen, Hai Phong and Hai Duong, with 2019 bars equal to or above 2009 bars in every province.
